_comment: Coverage floors, enforced by scripts/coverage-ratchet.mjs in the quality gate. A floor is the level a suite has already reached; it rises with `node scripts/coverage-ratchet.mjs --update` and nothing lowers it. Editing a number down by hand is the thing this file exists to make visible. The flowstarter-main numbers look low next to the other two, and they are: that package's coverage.include glob had a `src/` prefix it resolves without (package.json runs `vitest --root src`), so until 2026-09-09 v8 only reported the files a test happened to import and 414 source files were invisible. 47.5% is the whole tree. The number it replaces, 77.6%, was the covered half measuring itself.
